summary: Inotify event delivery can read an inotify mark watch descriptor while mark teardown concurrently resets the descriptor to -1.

call_chain.evidence: inotify_user.ll contains the syscall-generated removal entry.
inotify_rm_watch calls fsnotify_destroy_mark on the mark.
inotify_freeing_mark invokes this helper through fsnotify ops.
Helper removes the mark and resets wd.

interleaving: fsnotify dispatches an inode event to inotify_handle_inode_event and it derives i_mark from the fsnotify mark.
A concurrent watch removal destroys the mark, removes it from the inotify idr, and resets i_mark->wd to -1.
Without sampling and validating wd, event delivery can queue an event with invalid watch descriptor -1.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: Event delivery must not report a descriptor after mark teardown invalidates it; the fix samples wd with READ_ONCE and drops events with wd == -1.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: wd is the userspace-visible watch descriptor; racing teardown can invalidate it while event delivery copies it into a queued event.

aliases.name: i_mark->wd
aliases.evidence: i_mark is container_of(inode_mark, struct inotify_inode_mark, fsn_mark).

aliases.name: i_mark->wd
aliases.evidence: Removal helper resets the watch descriptor after idr_remove.

aliases.name: event->wd
aliases.evidence: The event stores a copy of i_mark->wd for userspace.

thread_a.evidence: Event handler converts fsnotify_mark to inotify_inode_mark.

thread_b.evidence: Removal finds the mark in the group idr and passes it to inotify_remove_from_idr.

allocated_by: inotify watch creation allocates struct inotify_inode_mark
published_by: watch insertion assigns wd and stores the mark in group->inotify_data.idr
invalidated_by: inotify_remove_from_idr removes the idr entry and sets wd to -1
freed_by: fsnotify mark reference release after destroy

coverage.analysis_conclusion: The event callback, inotify ops, watch removal helper, and wd reset are represented; fsnotify core mark destruction is a candidate indirect caller outside the repaired source set.

patch_hunks: c915d8f5918b samples i_mark->wd with READ_ONCE, checks wd == -1, and copies the sampled wd into event->wd.
entry_discovery_log: merged.ll defines inotify_handle_inode_event, inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr, and inotify_remove_from_idr.
repair_commands: Created a temporary vulnerable-revision worktree, copied matching inotify.h and fdinfo.h, compiled inotify_user.c with clang-15 and -DCC_USING_FENTRY=1, and linked with inotify_fsnotify.ll.
notes: Initial compile against the main checkout failed due cross-revision fsnotify flag names and missing ../fdinfo.h; vulnerable-revision headers fixed it.
